title: Change Customer keeps today's caption and adds the pricing sentence
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open work order 1's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Change Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Change Customer, Split Work Order and Back to Work Orders.

Step 3:

  • The dialog shows today's gray caption, as in the Today picture.
  • It adds "Parts already on the work order keep their prices, and new parts keep this work order's pricing."
